findings.title: Main content takes 16.9s to appear on mobile

findings.title: Page is unresponsive for 0.7s while loading
findings.fix: Split and defer JavaScript, remove unused third-party scripts.
findings.impact: Taps and scrolls feel broken while scripts run, so visitors leave before they act.

findings.impact: Faster pages convert better and rank higher.

findings.fix: Use a 16px base font size and a fluid type scale.
findings.impact: Unreadable copy means the message never lands.
